intent: Ten original school-notice tasks connect an entrance picture to exact meeting/waiting evidence,contrast bring/provide,require both demonstration and permission,check eligibility plus signup,and follow conditional and dated updates without changing retained rules. workshop.title: 校园通知：找入口，守条件，读更新
workshop.instruction: 点入口、连证据；看清先做什么、什么时候改安排，以及哪些要求仍有效。

items.label: 找对入口，还要等老师
items.prompt: In the original dry-weather plan, where should students meet and what should they do there?
items.answer: Meet at the blue side gate and wait for Ms Chen.
items.reason: 先到蓝色侧门，再在那里等陈老师。两句分别交代集合地点和到达后的动作；不能自己先去操作工具。
items.hint: 先核对这题依据原通知还是更新，再找人物、地点、条件和必须完成的动作。
items.material:
GARDEN MAKERS — FRIDAY
Meet at the blue side gate at 3:35 p.m., not at the main front entrance.
Wait for Ms Chen there; she will take the group to the garden tables.
Watch Ms Chen's demonstration before you use scissors.
Use scissors only after Ms Chen gives you permission.
Work with a partner to make plant labels.
Bring a pencil.
The school provides card, string and scissors.
Beginners are welcome.
Send your name to Ms Chen by Thursday at noon.
The workshop ends at 4:20 p.m.
If rain makes the path slippery, meet in Room 8 instead and design labels on paper.
Do not wait at the main front entrance.

ROBOT CLUB
Original notice: Meet in Lab 2 at 3:50 p.m. The session ends at 4:35 p.m. Work in pairs. Bring a pencil; the school provides the kits.
Update for this Wednesday: Meet in Room 6 at 4:05 p.m. The end time and all other instructions stay the same.
transfer.stem: Which statement matches the update and the instructions that still apply?

options.text: Meet in Lab 2 for a 45-minute session.
Meet in Room 6 and bring your own kit.
Meet in Room 6, work in pairs and finish after 30 minutes.

answer.display: Meet in Room 6, work in pairs and finish after 30 minutes.

explanation.strategy: 先替换更新点，再保留明确不变的要求；用新起点和保留的终点算时长。
